summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of inoculants on microstructure evolution during selective laser melting of IN718 superalloy.
summary_en.method: Inoculants were added during SLM processing, and microstructure was characterized via SEM and EBSD.
summary_en.result: The inoculants significantly altered grain morphology and refined grain size.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization using SEM and EBSD analyses.

papers.title: Review of rehabilitation after geriatric total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract:
Artificial hip arthroplasty is one of the effective methods to treat hip diseases nowadays, it has been widely applied in a variety of hip diseases, especially in aged patients. In order to reduce the risk of various complications after total hip arthroplasty and maintain the stability of the hip joint, it is important to take reasonable postoperative rehabilitations. We consult relevant domestic and foreign literature, summarize current problems of rehabilitation training after hip replacement to provide a reference for postoperative patients with reasonable rehabilitation plan.


Key words: 
Arthroplasty, replacement, hip; Rehabilitation; Review

papers.abstract: Keywords Complete Abductor Detachament, Direct Lateral Approach, Abductor Insuffenciency, Hip Arthroplasty Backgroung Approach of Total hip replacement (THR) is a very important part of the surgery...

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文聚焦髋关节置换术中入路相关的临床并发症，未涉及任何生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study of surgical approaches for THA, with no biomechanical modeling, implant stress analysis, micromotion, or bone remodeling quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较完全外展肌剥离入路与直接外侧入路在髋关节置换术中的并发症发生率
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析两种入路手术患者的临床数据，对比脱位、外展肌无力等并发症
summary_zh.result: 完全外展肌剥离入路脱位率较低，但外展肌功能不全发生率更高
summary_zh.validation: 基于医院病例的回顾性临床对比研究

summary_en.motivation: To compare postoperative complications between the complete abductor detachment and direct lateral approaches in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of clinical data from patients undergoing THA via either approach, evaluating dislocation, abductor insufficiency, and other outcomes.
summary_en.result: The complete abductor detachment approach showed lower dislocation rates but higher abductor dysfunction compared to the direct lateral approach.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective single-center clinical study with no biomechanical testing or computational modeling.
